sources.quoteId: chat/create max_tokens — 'This value is now deprecated in favor of max_completion_tokens, and is not compatible with o-series models' (verified 2026-08-03)

notes.migration: Request-side rename: max_tokens: N becomes max_completion_tokens: N on chat.completions.create calls. Semantics caveat: on reasoning models max_completion_tokens counts reasoning + visible output tokens, so an unchanged N may yield shorter visible output; the rename is behavior-preserving on non-reasoning models.
notes.removalDate: None announced as of 2026-08-03; max_tokens still accepted on non-o-series models. Urgency: requests sending max_tokens to o-series/reasoning models fail TODAY — this is live breakage on model upgrade, not hygiene.
edgeCases: Repos passing max_tokens through a shared config/options object need the rename at the config source, not the call site
notes.citationQuality: The API-reference deprecation is undated and there is no changelog entry; announcedAt is anchored to the o-series (o1) launch that introduced the incompatibility
